classification_rules.never_had_a_row: no verdict row at all (command null / no-verdict, no journal verdict event)
classification_rules.blocked_by_another_card: the failure names a file or test owned by a different card (none found)
classification_rules.superseded_or_duplicate: a later card redid the work and settled (named in the row's successor field)
